description: Workflow evaluation cases (SPEC-006 layer 4). Each case runs in a temporary fixture workspace; tests inspect filesystem, command results, manifests, and hashes — model prose alone is not proof.

cases.prompt: Inspect this repository and identify every Pollux generator surface and target status.
assertions: identifies all four generator surfaces: manager, generated/generated-server, go-backend, standalone
lists experimental status for nextjs, react-router, astro targets
makes no filesystem writes

cases.prompt: Create a new Pollux Next.js workspace in the empty requested directory.
assertions: .pollux/workspace.json provenance exists with skeleton, adapter, and versions
no staging residue remains in the destination parent
unrelated files in the destination parent are byte-identical

cases.prompt: Create a Pollux Next.js workspace at this non-empty destination without overwriting its files.
assertions: fails with DESTINATION_NOT_EMPTY
pre-existing directory contents are byte-identical

cases.prompt: Select the packaged layout and design tokens for this Next.js Pollux workspace.
steps: select layout resource for the workspace target
assertions: selects layout.nextjs plus design.tokens, never another target's shell
no framework-crossing imports appear in edited files
routes/loaders/handlers unchanged

cases.prompt: Regenerate the legacy TypeScript CRUD entity through the canonical Pollux CLI and verify drift.
assertions: uses canonical CLI, never hygen/gohygen directly
drift gate passes after fmt
only generator-owned paths changed

cases.prompt: Plan and generate rich-valid CRUD into this standalone Next.js workspace, then verify ownership.
assertions: plan performs no writes
generate is journaled and all-or-nothing
check-generated passes after generate

cases.prompt: Regenerate and verify the Pollux Go backend using the explicit backend selector.
assertions: uses the canonical backend selector with an explicit go backend
Go generation and verification complete successfully
only generated/pollux-go paths change, or regeneration is a byte fixpoint

cases.prompt: Choose the smallest sufficient verification gates for these Pollux plugin and template changes.
steps: map changed paths to catalog resource IDs
run layer 1-2 gates for plugin changes only
assertions: plugin-only changes do not trigger workspace matrices
template changes trigger ./pollux check
result separates package, host, generator, and runtime gates

cases.prompt: Attempt the requested unknown entity generation safely and preserve unrelated dirty files on failure.
assertions: fails with a stable code (PLAN_INVALID)
unrelated dirty files remain byte-identical
no partial generated output or journal residue beyond recovered state
